remembrance: observed-in-code gobreaker.go:271 ("return func(success bool) {"). A caller-held continuation records a generation and retains its wrapper. No individual completion or queue is stored by the breaker. Lifecycle replacement creates an independent instance. A late callback refreshes then compares generation. gobreaker.go:298 ("state, generation := cb.currentState(now)"). gobreaker.go:299 ("if generation != before {"). observed-in-code gobreaker.go:56 ("c.Requests++"). Requests counts admissions per generation, independent of caller departure. Successful reports update outcome counters until a state change or interval refresh clears all five. A half-open failure goes straight to a state change. Rejection and stale contribution do not increment outcomes. gobreaker.go:285 ("} else if state == StateHalfOpen && cb.counts.Requests >= cb.maxRequests {"). gobreaker.go:330 ("cb.setState(StateOpen, now)"). gobreaker.go:365 ("cb.counts.clear()"). No queue backing store. Retained closure footprint or collection timing is a runtime question. observed-in-code gobreaker.go:128 ("generation uint64"). Only the current generation is retained, bounded by uint64. Counts use uint32 fields. HalfOpen has no expiry. gobreaker.go:48 ("Requests             uint32"). gobreaker.go:378 ("cb.expiry = zero").
lock_discipline: observed-in-code gobreaker.go:207 ("cb.mutex.Lock()"). State holds the mutex across refresh and synchronous notification. Counts takes it only for the snapshot. Name reads the configured name without locking. gobreaker.go:217 ("cb.mutex.Lock()"). gobreaker.go:202 ("return cb.name"). observed-in-code gobreaker.go:277 ("cb.mutex.Lock()"). Admission holds the mutex across refresh, possible OnStateChange and its count decision. Completion holds it across refresh, ReadyToTrip and OnStateChange. gobreaker.go:294 ("cb.mutex.Lock()"). gobreaker.go:326 ("if cb.readyToTrip(cb.counts) {"). gobreaker.go:359 ("cb.onStateChange(cb.name, prev, state)"). observed-in-code gobreaker.go:242 ("result, err := req()"). Execute invokes request work and classifier after admission unlock and before completion lock. The contracts do not specify same-instance reentry or callback failure and blocking behavior. gobreaker.go:95 ("// ReadyToTrip is called with a copy of Counts whenever a request fails in the closed state."). gobreaker.go:100 ("// OnStateChange is called whenever the state of the CircuitBreaker changes."). gobreaker.go:102 ("// IsSuccessful is called with the error returned from a request.").
notes: The public topologies wrap Execute work directly or issue a continuation through Allow. Read methods exist in both. Reports and Execute results do not share one publicly constructed backing breaker across topologies. A construction targets a new breaker identity. Clock evaluation is internal.
